author: Oda, Tadao
title: The first de Rham cohomology group and Dieudonné modules
locators: Definition3.1; Propositions3.22–3.24, pp99–101; Corollary5.11 and its remark, p131; bibliography[15], p134. Original p131 visually inspected.
first_circulation: Modified Harvard dissertation submitted June1967, stated in introduction; publication1969.
journal: Annales scientifiques de l’École Normale Supérieure
limitations: Perfect base field; the abelian-variety comparison identifies M(X[p]) with H1_dR. It does not compute the manuscript’s particular determinant-orientation class.

author: Grothendieck, Alexander
title: Le groupe de Brauer: II. Théories cohomologiques
locators: Lemma1.1, Corollaries1.2–1.3, Proposition1.4, pp290–291; original formula pages visually inspected.
first_circulation: Bourbaki exposé297; seminar1965/66, volume1966. Exact lecture month not yet independently read.
limitations: Cor1.3 assumes noetherian without embedded associated primes, or reduced qcqs with finitely many components. Prop1.4 additionally assumes strict henselian local factoriality; Hq(Gm) torsion only forq≥2.

author: Lang, Serge
title: Algebraic groups over finite fields
locators: Theorem1 and corollary; Theorem2, pp557–558, visually inspected; introductionp555.
first_circulation: Received1956-03-09, printed first page; publication1956. Earlier public circulation not established.
limitations: Connected algebraic groups over finite fields; gives existence/isomorphism classes of torsors, not a preferred point. Smooth henselian lifting and inverse limits are additional arguments.

author: Deuring, Max
title: Die Typen der Multiplikatorenringe elliptischer Funktionenkörper
locators: Introduction§§2–3, pp198–200; quaternionic maximal-order and j-invariant classification.
first_circulation: Publication1941; earlier public circulation not established.
journal: Abhandlungen aus dem Mathematischen Seminar der Universität Hamburg
limitations: Classical supersingular/maximal-order results, not an exact norm-rigidified gerbe construction matching every manuscript coherence datum.

author: Voight, John
title: Quaternion algebras
locators: Chapter42, Theorem42.1.9; §42.2.4; Proposition42.4.8 and Corollary42.4.12.
first_circulation: Book2021; chapter first online2021-06-29. Earlier book drafts not used to claim priority.
limitations: Exact quaternion/maximal-order hypotheses retained; abstract bimodule groups and principal one-sided ideal classes are distinguished.

author: Silverman, Joseph H.
title: The arithmetic of elliptic curves
locators: III Theorem10.1 and Corollary10.2, pp103–104; V§3 for supersingularity.
first_circulation: First edition1986; second edition2009; consulted PDF corrected second printing2016.
limitations: Automorphism orders4and6 are for characteristic≠2,3 over an algebraic closure.

author: The Stacks Project Authors
title: Kummer theory, Lemma59.28.3, Tag040N
locators: Exact fppf Kummer sequence for every positive integern; checked current tag.
first_circulation: Continuously updated project; accessed2026-11-19. No priority date inferred.

author: The Stacks Project Authors
title: Lifting, Lemma15.9.14, Tag07M7
locators: Lifts a point of a smooth A-algebra after an étale base change preserving A/I.
first_circulation: Continuously updated project; accessed2026-11-19.

author: The Stacks Project Authors
title: Henselian local rings, Lemma10.153.3, Tag04GE
locators: Equivalent henselian conditions, especially(7)–(8) retractions of étale neighbourhoods with identical residue field.
first_circulation: Continuously updated project; accessed2026-11-19.

author: Milne, James S.
title: Complex multiplication
locators: Propositions1.36–1.39, pp20–21 in the file’s printed numbering: positive involutions and real/CM factor classification; §4.17–4.18 Serre condition.
first_circulation: v0.00 first posted2006-04-07; consulted v0.10 dated2020-07-14.
limitations: Positive involution allows totally real identity-involution factors as well as CM factors. A connected torus hypothesis is separate.

author: Milne, James S.
title: Algebraic groups: The theory of group schemes of finite type over a field
locators: Corollary14.42 p239: rational points of a torus over an infinite field are Zariski dense.
Corollary27.56 p488: H1(k,G)=1 for connected group varieties over finite fields.
Chapters12–14: character/diagonalizable-group dictionary; chapter25: split reductive groups and root data.
first_circulation: v1.00 posted2014-07-31; consulted v2.00 dated2015-12-20.
limitations: Density does not extend to arbitrary disconnected multiplicative-type groups; these are finite-type statements.

author: Milne, James S.
title: Abelian varieties with complex multiplication (for pedestrians)
locators: §4, pp9–12, Serre group character lattice and Lemma4.2 norm relation.
first_circulation: Disseminated September1981; author’s corrected and expanded text dated1998-06-07, explicitly stated on first page.
limitations: Provides a later comparison method, not an identification of the manuscript’s particular torus with the universal Serre group.

author: Milne, James S.
title: Gerbes and abelian motives
locators: §6.1 conditional motivic interpretation; Theorem6.3 and Remark6.4, pp36–37, existence/uniqueness of pseudomotivic gerbe systems and weight-zero variant.
first_circulation: Consulted author version1.1 dated2003-02-21; original public circulation date not established.
limitations: The pseudomotivic gerbe theorem is unconditional as a specified gerbe problem; identifying it with all geometric motives retains Tate/Hodge hypotheses. It is not the exact integral Deuring orientation problem.

author: Grothendieck, Alexander
title: On the de Rham cohomology of algebraic varieties
locators: Theorem1 and variant1′, pp95–96; p102 discussion of p-kernel and Hodge exact sequences; footnote10 period relations; p103 footnotes12–13. Original pp102–103 visually inspected.
first_circulation: Letter to Atiyah dated1963-10-14; most editorial remarks November1963; received1965-07-05; footnote13 added July1965; publication1966. These dates were read on the original first and last pages.
limitations: The period-conjecture footnote is distinct from the p-kernel comparison proved by Oda. Footnote12 retracts naive characteristic-p dimension/base-change hopes.

author: Grothendieck, Alexander
title: Site et topos étales d’un schéma (Exposé VII)
locators: §4 Proposition4.1, original exposé pp11–12 (folio352–353): fully faithful small-to-big étale pullback and cohomology comparison.
first_circulation: Seminar1963–1964; SGA4 tome2 publication1972. Original draft numbering differs from the later edited references.
booktitle: Théorie des topos et cohomologie étale des schémas
limitations: Both sites carry the étale topology. This is not a blanket comparison of étale with fppf/fpqc cohomology.

author: Deligne, Pierre, d’après Alexander Grothendieck
title: La formule de dualité globale (Exposé XVIII)
locators: §1.4.11 two-term complex construction; Lemma1.4.13 and Proposition1.4.15 Picard-stack/derived-complex equivalence; §1.4.21 torsors.
first_circulation: SGA4 seminar1963–1964; tome3 publication1973; exact circulation date of this edited exposé not established.
booktitle: Théorie des topos et cohomologie étale des schémas
limitations: Strictly commutative Picard stacks and additive functors; a monoidal functor need not preserve a chosen symmetry unless required.

author: Humphreys, James E.
title: Reflection groups and Coxeter groups
locators: §2.12 exceptional Weyl groups; §2.11 orders; §2.5 Cartan determinants.
first_circulation: Publication1990; historical references there to Bourbaki VI exercises pp228–229 and the classical finite groups.
limitations: Group-symbol conventions differ: the simple order25920 group is the derived/spinor kernel, not the full order51840 determinant-one orthogonal group in the manuscript convention.

author: Grothendieck Circle
title: Bibliographie d’Alexander Grothendieck
locators: Entries for BrauerII, deRham1966, standard conjectures1969 and Hodge general conjecture1969.
first_circulation: Accessed2026-11-19; no creation date asserted.
limitations: Used only to trace publications backward, not as proof of any mathematical claim.

author: Grothendieck, Alexander
title: Hodge’s general conjecture is false for trivial reasons
locators: §1 pp299–300 cubic elliptic-period counterexample; §2 pp300–301 corrected maximal rational sub-Hodge structure and motivic effectivity; §3 special cases.
first_circulation: Received27October1968; additionApril1969; publication1969. No earlier circulation date established.
limitations: Refutes the naive generalized Hodge filtration equality, not the usual rational Hodge conjecture. The real-base restriction-of-scalars variant is this run’s reconstruction.

author: Bost, Jean-Benoît and Charles, François
title: Some remarks concerning the Grothendieck period conjecture
locators: §1.1 comparison and cycle classes; §2.1 integral/rational deRham–Betti categories; Conjecture2.12 and Proposition2.13 distinguish period torsor and cycle fullness.
first_circulation: arXiv1307.1045 first3July2013, revised9April2014; publisher online30April2014; volume714 publication2016.
journal: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik
limitations: The integral Betti component of the defined category is finite free. General integral cohomology may contain torsion. The full transcendence statement is conjectural; special GPC results are not its general proof.

author: Grothendieck, Alexander
title: Le groupe fondamental: généralités (SGA1, ExposéV)
locators: Theorem4.1; Proposition5.6 and Corollary5.7; §7 geometric points and paths; reedition pp104,106–107,115–116 (original marginal pp126–130,140–142).
first_circulation: Seminar1960–1961, mimeographed distribution described in introduction; LNM224 publication1971; recomposed SMF edition2003, arXiv first20June2002, v2 4January2004.
limitations: The consulted §7 assumes a connected locally noetherian scheme. Fibre functors are isomorphic noncanonically; their isomorphisms form a groupoid/path torsor.

author: Artin, Michael
title: Théorème de changement de base par un morphisme lisse, et applications (SGA4, ExposéXVI)
locators: Theorem4.1, original pp232–233, reedition p149/PDF156, finite-type complex schemes and torsion comparison; proper morphism or constructible coefficient condition.
first_circulation: Seminar1963–1964; original LNM305 publication1973; consulted electronic recomposition retains original marginal page numbers.
booktitle: Théorie des topos et cohomologie étale des schémas, tome3
limitations: The theorem is stated for torsion coefficients; integral ℓ-adic comparison requires the compatible inverse system, not an assertion that all integral cohomology is free.

author: Humphreys, James E.
title: Introduction to Lie algebras and representation theory
locators: §6.3 p28 Weyl complete reducibility; §7.2 pp32–33 divided-power recurrence; §§8.1–8.5 pp35–40 root/Killing properties; §§15.1–15.4 pp78–81 generalized weights and Cartan subalgebras; §16.2–16.4 pp82–85 conjugacy. Selected published pages rendered and OCR read.
first_circulation: Book copyright1972; Springer print release23January1973. Classical results predate this modern exposition; no precise earliest historical attribution is inferred here.
limitations: Generally algebraically closed characteristic0; §15 explicitly allows arbitrary characteristic for specified existence/Engel statements. The manuscript’s missing draft-relative hypotheses are not reconstructed from this book.

author: Bourbaki, Nicolas
title: Groupes et algèbres de Lie, chapitres7 et8
locators: Publisher metadata verifies originalMasson1975 and later reprint; opened English contents givesVII§§1–3 andVIII§§1–3,11–12 subject locations. Full theorem bodies were not accessible here; mathematical checks instead use Humphreys1972 and explicit proofs.
first_circulation: OriginalFrench chaptersVII–VIII published1975; French reprint2006/ebook2007. EnglishVII–IX contents is a later translation, not evidence of a manuscript date.
limitations: Verified only as publication/contents comparison. Never used as an independently checked theorem text or identification of the manuscript’s editorial numbers.
